CrawlEngine with defaults streams events like the free function

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'max_depth' => 1 }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
url_req = Crawlberg::CrawlStreamRequest.new(url: url)
result = Crawlberg.crawl_stream(engine, url_req).to_a
puts result.inspect
```
